turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I know who you are. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on the zero?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so who decided on the zero, and what do you have?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. I'm not here to word your letters to other parents. I'm here about Owen, and the zero comes off.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
Save the flattery, Hale. I'm not writing it, and I'm not here to be useful to you. Who decided on the zero?
